report.summary: Both failures have one cause: the running app accepts a book dated next year, when validate_book should reject it. The seeded year_off_by_one flag (app/main.py:94) is the only code path that does this, and nothing in the repo or workflow sets BUGS, so first check the CI runner environment for BUGS=year_off_by_one or a BASE_URL pointing at a differently configured app.

causes.title: App accepts a publication year of next year (year_off_by_one behaviour)
causes.explanation: validate_book computes max_year as this_year + 1 when 'year_off_by_one' is in BUGS, so a book with year = today's year + 1 passes validation. The API returns 201 instead of 422, and the UI saves the 2027 book to the table instead of showing the 'Year must be between' error. Both tests are correct to fail, since the rule is that years must not exceed the current year. The defect is deterministic, not timing-related. The repo and workflow do not set BUGS, so the flag must be coming from the environment the app was started in (the test fixture passes os.environ through to uvicorn in tests/conftest.py:57). That makes this a product defect only if the flag is meant to be on for this run; if it leaked in from the runner, the fix is environmental.
evidence: app/main.py:94: max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year
app/main.py:95-96: if not 1 <= book.year <= max_year: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:44: expect(books.error).to_contain_text("Year must be between") -> Actual value: None, element(s) not found
UI aria snapshot shows row "Future-75f0a181 Someone 2027 Delete", so the next-year book was saved
tests/conftest.py:57: env = {**os.environ, "DB_PATH": db_path} (BUGS is inherited from the environment)
.github/workflows/tests.yml sets no BUGS variable; a repo-wide search finds BUGS only in app/main.py
causes.suggested_fix: First, check the CI runner and any shell or secrets config for BUGS=year_off_by_one and for BASE_URL/APP_DB_PATH. If the flag is set there unintentionally, remove it so the app starts clean. If the seeded defect is meant to be on for this run, fix validate_book to remove the year_off_by_one branch (or make max_year always this_year) and keep the tests as they are. Consider pinning BUGS explicitly in the workflow so the run's configuration is visible in the repo.
